products.note: AI: Be My AI image description. Who: Blind and low-vision users. Student age: Users must be at least 17 (Perkins School for the Blind). Privacy: Consumer terms. Price: Free.

profile_text.body:
Be My Eyes is an accessibility technology company that connects blind or low vision users with volunteers and companies worldwide through live video and AI. The company describes its service as offering real-time assistance via video, with users requesting help from volunteers when they need it.

Its AI product is Be My AI, an image description tool. According to the company's own materials, Be My AI is free, aimed at blind and low vision users, and requires users to be at least 17 years old, a detail attributed to the Perkins School for the Blind. The site notes that consumer terms apply to the service. The company's site also shows an image generated with Be My AI, depicting a woman with sunglasses and a white cane sharing a moment with a young girl on a scooter outdoors.
